title: Ada and the Interior
author: Hazel Vasquez
blurb: Lior Winterbourne, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
